name: momentum-strict
description: score_momentum only enters launches with a risk score of 25 or less (default 35): fewer, cleaner entries.

name: momentum-loose
description: score_momentum accepts risk scores up to 50 (default 35): more entries, more rugs.

name: momentum-low-buyers
description: score_momentum needs 8 unique buyers per minute instead of 15: enters quieter launches.

name: fast-exits
description: Bank half at 1.5x, trail tighter (15% from 1.2x peak, 10% from 3x) and time-stop flat positions after 120s.

name: no-time-stop
description: Never time-stop flat positions (time stop after 24h, so max hold and the other exits decide).

name: trade-blocked-event-exits
description: Trade launches the scorer hard-blocks or rates too risky (bundled, dev-heavy, clustered) and leave on dev or insider sells: tests whether bundled launches pump before they dump.
